subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop — proposed slots & pre-reqs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop — proposed slots & pre-reqs

Hi Oliver — great to speak this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can lock the dedicated-capacity sizing workshop (technical deep dive):

What we heard (short):
- BrightCart will be using the recommendation API for real-time personalization across web and mobile.
- Current baseline: ~50 RPS steady-state with traffic spikes to ~110–130 RPS during promotions; avg payload ~1.6k tokens, 95th around 2.0k.
- Target latency: p95 <= 150ms for the main online path; tolerances differ by region.
- Primary constraint: budgeted committed GPUs but need predictable throughput and isolation (Dedicated).

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute Dedicated Capacity Sizing workshop (technical attendees + sample traffic) where we:
1) Validate token/sequence distributions and peak concurrency
2) Walk through model variants/quantization tradeoffs and perf profiles
3) Run a rough capacity plan and recommended GPU pool configuration

Proposed time slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 2, 10:00–11:30 AM
- Wed Dec 3, 9:00–10:30 AM
- Thu Dec 4, 2:00–3:30 PM

Pre-reqs for the workshop (short):
- A sample 30–60 minute traffic snapshot (CSV or trace) containing token lengths + qps by minute
- Names + roles of attendees from your side (who will own infra and SRE questions)
- Any hard SLOs we should account for (p95, error budgets)

I attached a short agenda and example workload CSV to make it easier to prepare. Please let me know which slot works and who will join from BrightCart. If you prefer a different timezone, tell me and I’ll convert.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop — proposed slots & pre-reqs

Thanks Jasmine — helpful recap. We’d like to confirm a few items before we finalize the slot:

1) Attendees: I’m inviting our CTO Sarah Lee and infra lead Miguel Torres to the workshop. Sarah will drive product-level SLO decisions; Miguel will handle environment/access questions.
2) Traffic snapshot: we can upload a 24-hour sample with per-minute qps and token length distribution. Peak daily burst last promo was ~120 RPS sustained for ~8 minutes. Typical burst cushion needed is 2.5x baseline.
3) Do you need any temporary credentials or a VPN to run simulated traffic against a staging endpoint? We may have a security process to approve external traffic tests.

Preferred slot: Wed Dec 3, 9:00–10:30 AM PST works best for our team.

Oliver
VP Engineering, BrightCart

(646) 555-0199

Hi Oliver — Marcus here (solutions engineering). Thanks for confirming attendees — I’ll lead the sizing workstream for the technical deep dive. A few quick asks to make the workshop productive:

- Can you include a short example of a request payload (JSON) so we can estimate tokenization overhead?
- Please specify the p95 target you want honored for the live path and any secondary targets (p99, median) if applicable.
- For load test planning, do you prefer we run generator traffic from our Redwood-managed staging environment or provide a script you run from within BrightCart? If there’s an approval window for external traffic we should plan around it.

I’ll prep a short benchmark run plan and bring a small perf matrix for 8–16GB quantized variants. Confirmed preference: Wed Dec 3, 9:00–10:30 AM PST.

Thanks,
